design_rule: The barbell is an analytic framework, never a personal allocation. Reported performance comparison remains local, dated, and inseparable from its back-test and drawdown cautions.

clusters.purpose: Make the proposed separation of concentrated productive upside and deliberate defense visible as a rebalanced two-sleeve framework.
must_not_imply: that any listed defensive item must be held

clusters.purpose: Use the Market Leaders example to demonstrate that the five-hundred-stock boundary is not sacred while holding all performance and risk disclosures in a deterministic card.
clusters.asset_strategy: keep the barbell scene for the conceptual transition, then use the performance card as the center of gravity; return to the scene only for the stated tracking-error and research-burden costs.
must_not_imply: that a smaller screen is superior
